tasks.title: Update gxpush to append Closes #N to PR body
tasks.description: Extend gxpush to link PRs to GitHub issues by appending 'Closes #N' to PR_BODY before calling gh pr create. Two signals are checked in order: (1) $GITHUB_CLOSES env var (explicit path — expects a bare issue number like '42'), and (2) a regex extraction of gh-[0-9]+ from the branch name (self-discovery fallback). When either signal yields a number, append '\n\nCloses #N' to PR_BODY. When neither is present, skip silently — no warning, no change to PR body. The env var takes precedence when both are present.
acceptance_criteria: When GITHUB_CLOSES=42 is set, the PR body contains 'Closes #42' on a new line
When the branch name contains gh-42, the PR body contains 'Closes #42' on a new line
When both signals are present, GITHUB_CLOSES takes precedence
When neither signal is present, PR body is unchanged from pr-desc output
Shell test or manual smoke test: run gxpush --dry-run (or equivalent) with each signal combination and verify PR_BODY contents
tasks.summary: Extended gxpush to append 'Closes #N' to PR_BODY before gh pr create: checks $GITHUB_CLOSES env var first, falls back to extracting gh-[0-9]+ from branch slug, skips silently when neither is present. Added a standalone bash test script with 7 tests (10 assertions) covering all signal combinations.

tasks.title: Wire build-code SKILL.md and branching-strategy.md to encode gh-N
tasks.description: Update build-code SKILL.md and branching-strategy.md so the AI encodes the GitHub issue number in the branch name and sets GITHUB_CLOSES before calling gxpush. In SKILL.md: when processing a task, read export_url from the task JSON. If export_url is non-null and matches a GitHub issue URL, extract the issue number (last path segment of the URL). Encode it as a gh-N segment in the branch name immediately after the task ID segment (e.g. feat/t-0023-gh-42-bootstrap-auth). Set GITHUB_CLOSES=N in the shell environment before calling gxpush. If export_url is null or absent, skip both steps silently. In branching-strategy.md: document the optional gh-N segment and its position in the branch name format.
acceptance_criteria: build-code SKILL.md documents the export_url read, issue number extraction, gh-N branch encoding, and GITHUB_CLOSES env var steps
build-code SKILL.md documents the silent-skip behavior when export_url is null
branching-strategy.md shows the gh-N segment in the branch name format (e.g. {prefix}/t-{id}-gh-{issue}-{slug})
End-to-end smoke test: run build-code against a task whose export_url is set to a GitHub issue URL and confirm the created branch contains gh-N and the PR body contains 'Closes #N'
tasks.summary: Updated build-code SKILL.md step 4c to read export_url from the task object, extract the GitHub issue number when the URL matches a GitHub issue pattern, encode it as gh-N in the branch name after the task-ID segment, and set GITHUB_CLOSES=N before gxpush runs. Updated branching-strategy.md to document the optional gh-N segment with examples.
